name: Shelf Audit Agent
description: Crawls a site 3 levels deep (plus the JSON endpoints behind client-rendered shelves), collects the products a visitor can actually reach, and verifies each against the Amazon Product API: price drift, whether the stored image is genuinely the same picture, availability, and required fields. Unlike the DB-driven catalog agents it picks targets from the rendered site, so products that are neither featured nor article-linked stop falling through. Per-site instances: specpicks/agents/shelf-audit-agent, aisleprompt/agents/shelf-audit-agent.
